component.name: Tadpole
component.summary: Audit websites and explore their internal links

description.p: Tadpole is a desktop SEO crawler for inspecting website structure, metadata, indexability, internal links, and sitemap reconciliation.

Triage grouped Issues across four Severity tiers in the native Issues workspace, explore site structure with directory and link visualizations, save .tadpole Projects (with legacy .seocrawl read support), and export developer-ready Markdown or CSV reports. Optional AI metadata suggestions require your own provider API key.

Make Crawl Results columns resizable with sensible default widths and word wrapping, sync Open in Crawl Results jumps from Issues to the matching SEO Audit Filter, and prevent wrapping labels in hidden tabs from expanding the window past the screen.

Triage crawl and sitemap findings in a dedicated Issues workspace ranked across four Severity tiers, export developer-ready Markdown and CSV audit reports, and save or double-click .tadpole Projects while keeping legacy .seocrawl files readable.
Compare XML and gzip sitemaps with observed internal links, inspect candidate orphan pages and sitemap response or indexability findings, and save or export discovery evidence with crawl coverage.
Inspect links in wrapping tables with anchors and targets, preview images with resolution and alt text, and review richer Open Graph and Twitter cards.
